primer: Coforge Limited (NSE: COFORGE) is a domain-led Indian IT and digital engineering compounder. Its 12-month executable order book reached $2.38 billion in Q2 FY27, and management raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16.0%. Following the $2.35 billion Encora acquisition in May 2026, the stock closed at ₹2,010.00 on November 16, 2026 inside its Stage 2 support zone. We assign a Tier-2 ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP with a ₹2,620.00 Base target and a ₹1,659.40 structural stop.
